meta_description:
3,476 likes, 34 comments - passionpassport on April 14, 2022: "Cusco Off the Beaten Path with @jpwilliamsmedia 

“For countless reasons Peru is one of the most diverse, culturally rich countries in the world. Machu Picchu is just as magical as it seems, but there is so much more to this country and the region of Cusco than just one archeological site.” 

If you are eager to embark off the beaten path, checkout these spots so you too can experience more to Machu Picchu 🇵🇪 

📍Salineras de Maras
📍Moray Cuzco 
📍Urubamba
📍Valle Sagrado de los Incas
📍Ollantaytambo 

📸 @jpwilliamsmedia 

#passionpassport #peru #machupicchu".
